jar: Have a small picnic for two
Pack puff-puff, fruit and a cold drink, and find a quiet spot outside, even your own balcony. Phones away for one hour.
Why it helps: simple, unhurried time together reminds you that you are a family already.
Pick 10 songs that make you smile, old-school, Afrobeats or worship. Play it whenever the day feels heavy.
Why it helps: music you love is a quick way back to yourself.
Each night this week, write or say three things you are thankful for today, however small.
Why it helps: gratitude gently trains your eyes to notice the good God is still doing.
Choose one drawer, shelf or bag and clear it out. Give away what you don’t need.
Why it helps: a little order on the outside often brings a little calm on the inside.
Learn a new hymn or song
Pick a hymn or song you’ve always liked and learn all the words this week. Sing it in the shower.
Why it helps: learning something new gives your mind a gentle place to rest.
Check on a friend who checks on you
Send a voice note to the friend who always asks how you are. This time, ask about her.
Why it helps: giving care, not only receiving it, fills your heart too.
